Which centre will this bridge connect to? Choose, then paste the API code of the bridge record created in that centre\'s Support → Bridges panel. The code carries the identity and the address; no address, port or token is entered.
GRCON — Central Server (online centre at goktungu.com)
GRCOFF — Local Installation (your own closed-network Centre Application)
Copy the code from Support → Bridges in the GRCON centre application. The code is erased at the centre once the bridge connects; if lost, use Renew code in the panel.
Copy the code from Support → Bridges in your local Centre Application (GRCOFF). The phone and GRCOFF must share a network. The code is erased on first connection; if lost, use Renew code.
Identity saved; connecting to the centre
This API code was issued for %1$s; the setup choice is %2$s. Enter the right code or change the choice.
Complete the setup with an API code first.
Start the bridge automatically when the app opens
The DJI link is opened from the centre\'s Connection Manager (DJI Bridge → this bridge). The aircraft on the remote controller appears at the centre once the channel is open.
Reset identity (enter a new API code)
The bridge stops and the setup identity is deleted. Reconnecting requires a new API code (Renew code) from the centre.
Bridge started; connecting to the centre
Warning: the target latitude and longitude are nearly equal; an axis swap cannot be distinguished.
Keeps the bridge connection alive during flight
The bridge needs location and notification permissions to report the aircraft position to the centre.
Location permission denied; telemetry cannot be reported.

This application uses DJI Mobile SDK v5, linked dynamically under DJI\'s licence terms. The centre link is a secure WebSocket paired with the API code issued in the centre\'s Support → Bridges panel; the centre opens the DJI link from its Connection Manager.
